title: Solstice SMP
description: A Client-Side Pack that greatly enhances fun.
body: This project is a client-side modpack made to enhance gameplay on Solstice SMP. It includes new sounds, shaders, great performance, texture packs and some QoL feautures, including MouseTweaks, a bette rUI, the AL's texture series and voice chat, as well as hunger preview and animated items.
